notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hajimemashite!

Thankyou for playing Japanese Romaji Adventure 3D!



The demo has been de-activated temporarily.  We are working hard on getting as many of the updates in as we can, and we feel the current demo needs much work before we present it.

We [u]had to release it prematurely for the Steam event, per Steam's rules[/u], so now we're un-releasing it while we work on it, then re-release it on a later date.

Release date for the game is December 2022!  Please tell your friends to wishlist.
